how_to_apply: Visit the official UPSSSC website at upsssc.gov.in.
Open the section and select Advertisement No. 26-Exam/2026.
Read the official notification and select the application option.
Log in using the PET 2025 registration number and the required OTP verification through the registered mobile number or email address.
Review the personal details and PET-related information displayed in the application.
Complete the required educational qualification, category, reservation and other details.
Review the photograph and signature information associated with the PET registration.
Complete the declaration and proceed to the application fee payment section.
Pay the prescribed Rs. 25 processing fee using an available online payment option.
Verify successful payment and ensure that the application is finally submitted.
Download and print the completed application for future reference.

Important: Merely paying the processing fee does not automatically mean that every required application step has been completed. Candidates must confirm successful submission and save the completed form.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Lower Subordinate Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must satisfy the relevant post-wise recruitment rules, educational qualifications, age requirements and UPSSSC PET 2025 conditions. Candidates must have appeared in UPSSSC PET 2025 and possess a score issued by the Commission. Applicants will be shortlisted for the Main Examination on the basis of their PET 2025 normalized scores and merit, subject to the rules in the notification. Candidates with an absolute or normalized score of zero or less will not be shortlisted. Candidates provisionally appearing in PET 2025 results under investigation will be considered only in accordance with the Commission's final decisions. Educational qualifications differ by post. The notification refers to the prescribed recruitment service rules for each department and provides the required qualifications in its eligibility section. Applicants should verify the particular educational qualification, additional eligibility conditions and supporting certificates required for the post they intend to select. A qualification accepted for one post should not automatically be treated as valid for another post. Qualification Cut-off: Candidates must possess all mandatory educational and other eligibility qualifications by 1 December 2026 . Most posts carry a notified age range of 18 to 40 years , while the official notification provides post-wise variations and the applicable rules for calculating age. Applicants should read the age provisions for their selected post rather than relying only on the general age range. The notification includes particular age limits and reckoning rules for certain posts.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Lower Subordinate Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: UPSSSC has prescribed an online application processing fee of Rs. 25 for all categories listed below. The prescribed processing fee applies according to the notification's category and concession rules. Candidates selected for the Main Examination through PET 2025 shortlisting must separately pay the notified Main Examination fee before downloading the Main Examination admit card.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Lower Subordinate Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted through the PET 2025-based shortlisting process followed by the Main Written Examination and subsequent procedures prescribed by UPSSSC. Shortlisting using UPSSSC PET 2025 normalized scores. Main Written Examination for shortlisted candidates. Post allocation and merit-based selection under the notified rules. Verification of educational qualifications, category certificates and other eligibility documents. The Commission will publish the examination date and further selection instructions through its official website.

content_sections.heading: UPSSSC Lower Subordinate Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Main Written Examination will consist of 100 objective-type questions carrying 100 marks . The examination duration is 2 hours , and one-fourth of the assigned marks will be deducted for each incorrect answer. Examination Mode: Objective-type Written Examination Total Questions: 100 Total Marks: 100 Duration: 120 Minutes Negative Marking: 25% of marks assigned to the question for each wrong answer

content_sections.heading: Application Correction and Fee Adjustment
content_sections.text: The Commission has provided an additional period until 8 December 2026 for permitted application corrections and fee adjustment. Candidates should use the Applicant Dashboard and follow the relevant Modify Application and payment-verification instructions. The official notification contains specific restrictions concerning editable fields and corrections. New applications will not be accepted after 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in UPSSSC Lower Subordinate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UPSSSC has advertised 1,784 vacancies under Advertisement No. 26-Exam/2026.

faq.question: Q2. When does the online application start?
Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the required processing fee is 1 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is PET 2025 compulsory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must have participated in UPSSSC PET 2025 and satisfy the PET score and shortlisting conditions prescribed in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The online application processing fee is Rs. 25 for the listed categories. A separate Main Examination fee applies to shortlisted candidates at the relevant stage.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for UPSSSC Lower Subordinate Recruitment?
faq.answer: Most posts generally specify 18 to 40 years, but candidates must check the exact age requirements and applicable relaxations for their selected post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the UPSSSC Lower Subordinate exam pattern?
faq.answer: The Main Examination contains 100 objective questions for 100 marks, with a duration of 2 hours and one-fourth negative marking.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates make corrections after submitting the application?
faq.answer: The notification provides a correction and fee-adjustment window until 8 December 2026, subject to the prescribed restrictions.

faq.question: Q9. Where can candidates apply?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official UPSSSC website at upsssc.gov.in.
